name: The Last Romance
blurb: Florida Studio Theatre's summer mainstage comedy is in its closing week: Ralph, a widower, meets the elegant Carol and stumbles into an unexpected second chance at love. Warm, witty, and about 1 hour 50 minutes with intermission. Tickets through the FST box office at 941-366-9000 — an easy excuse to make a night of it downtown.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
blurb: Sarasota's most-photographed weekly ritual: drummers, dancers, hula hoopers and a few hundred onlookers gather on the quartz sand just south of the Siesta Beach pavilion as the sun drops into the Gulf. Free, no experience needed, and bringing your own drum is encouraged. Park early — the lot fills well before sunset.

name: Laser Light Nights at The Bishop
venue: The Bishop Museum of Science and Nature
blurb: The Bishop's planetarium dome becomes a full-surround laser concert, with shows built around Pink Floyd, Queen, Taylor Swift, Prince, The Beatles, Metallica and more. Tickets are $15 and shows regularly sell out, so book ahead. Beer, wine and snacks are sold in the planetarium lobby and can be taken into the theater.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Downtown Sarasota's Saturday-morning staple: fresh produce, flowers, baked goods, coffee and local makers spread along Lemon Avenue and Main Street. Free to browse and dog-friendly — and the single easiest way to see downtown at its liveliest. Go early to beat the August heat.
